description: Source code for MasqueClientSession class implementing MASQUE protocol client-side logic, including connection management, stream handling, and IP packet encapsulation.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession
classes.description: Client-side MASQUE protocol session managing streams, encapsulated IP/UDP sessions, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectUdpClientState
classes.description: Represents state for a CONNECT-UDP stream, handling HTTP/3 datagrams for UDP encapsulation.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectIpClientState
classes.description: Represents state for a CONNECT-IP stream, handling HTTP/3 datagrams and IP packet processing.

methods.name: GetOrCreateConnectUdpClientState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CONNECT-UDP client state for a given target server address and encapsulated session.

methods.name: GetOrCreateConnectIpClientState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a CONNECT-IP client state for a given encapsulated IP session.

methods.name: SendIpPacket
methods.description: Encapsulates and sends an IP packet over the MASQUE connection.

methods.name: SendPacket
methods.description: Sends a UDP packet to a target server address via MASQUE.

methods.name: CloseConnectUdpStream
methods.description: Closes all CONNECT-UDP streams associated with a given encapsulated client session.

methods.name: CloseConnectIpStream
methods.description: Closes all CONNECT-IP streams associated with a given encapsulated IP session.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure, closing all encapsulated sessions.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles stream closure events, cleaning up associated session states.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrame
methods.description: Processes received SETTINGS frame and verifies support for HTTP/3 datagrams.

methods.name: GetFakeAddress
methods.description: Generates and registers a fake IP address associated with a hostname.

methods.name: RemoveFakeAddress
methods.description: Removes a previously registered fake IP address.
